entries.source: StAN, Fürstentum Ansbach, Geheimes Archiv: Bauernkriegsakten 10/131
entries.german: Befehl Markgraf Kasimirs an die Räte zu Ansbach, den an Jörg Truchseß abzuordnenden Knecht Hansolfs von Rosenberg betreffend

facts.content: had a Knecht whose assignment to Jörg Truchseß was the subject of a command by Markgraf Kasimir to the Ansbach councillors.
